name: sunsynk
description: Read-only access to your Sunsynk Connect solar, battery and grid data.
long_description: Lets Claude read live and historical data from your Sunsynk inverter via the Sunsynk Connect cloud API (the same service the Sunsynk Connect app uses): solar generation, battery state of charge, grid import/export, household load, energy history and inverter settings. All tools are read-only; nothing is changed on the inverter. Your credentials are stored by Claude Desktop in your operating system's secure store and are only sent to api.sunsynk.net.

tools.name: sunsynk_list_plants
tools.description: List plants/sites with current PV power and generation totals

tools.name: sunsynk_list_inverters
tools.description: List inverters with serial numbers, firmware and status

tools.name: sunsynk_live_status
tools.description: Live solar, battery, grid, load and output snapshot

tools.name: sunsynk_inverter_settings
tools.description: Read the inverter's configuration (work mode, time-of-use, battery limits)

tools.name: sunsynk_api_get
tools.description: Read-only GET against any Sunsynk api/v1 endpoint

username.title: Sunsynk Connect email
username.description: The email you use to sign in to the Sunsynk Connect app / sunsynk.net

password.title: Sunsynk Connect password
password.description: Stored securely by Claude Desktop; only sent to api.sunsynk.net
